article.title: Hong Kong fact of the day
article.excerpt: Seventy-six per cent of Hongkongers aged 18-35 are still living with their parents, according to the Urban Research Group of City University of Hong Kong, despite an unemployment rate of just 3 per cent. That is almost twice the level of the US, the UK or France. According to the FT piece , many married couples still live separately, and with their parents.

article.title: Hong Kong fact and projection of the day
article.excerpt: Hong Kong is a tough marriage market for women because of the city’s skewed gender ratio — 876 males for every 1,000 females, a gap predicted to worsen to 712 to 1,000 by 2041. That is from Julie Zhu at the FT .
